subject: Gatehouse crate
text: Inside the Gatehouse near the drawbridge into Hyrule Castle, rolling into the two crates near the guard in the back of the room reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The Gatehouse is the small building near the drawbridge into Hyrule Castle.
Roll into the two crates near the guard in the back of the room.  In one of
them is a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token.

subject: Garden entrance tree
text: Rolling into the large tree near the entrance to the Garden causes a Gold Skulltula to fall from the branches.

evidence.quote:
Roll into the large tree near the entrance to the Garden.  This is the same
tree that Kaepora Gaebora sits in when you first arrive in the garden.  A Gold
Skulltula will fall from the branches.

subject: Ganon's Castle marble arch
text: At Ganon's Castle in the future, a Gold Skulltula hangs above the lava on the back right side of the shattered marble arch and can be taken with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Head for Ganon's Castle in the future, and look to the back of the shattered
marble arch to see a Gold Skulltula.  It hangs above the lava on the right side
of the arch, facing it from the back.  Kill it and take it's token with the
Hookshot.

subject: Hyrule Castle Garden tree pit
text: Playing the Song of Storms beneath the tree at the corner of the moat reveals a pit where bombing one of three walls reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
At the corner of the
moat, there is a tree.  Stand beneath the tree and play the Song of Storms to
reveal a pit.  Drop down the pit, and bomb the three walls in the room.  Behind
one of the walls is the Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the
Boomerang.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch second story window
text: On the tall second story building to the left of the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch, a Gold Skulltula crawls on one of the second story windows.

evidence.quote:
Look on the tall second story building to the left of the entrance to Lon Lon
Ranch.  The Gold Skulltula crawls around on one of the second story windows.
Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch paddock tree
text: Rolling into the tree southwest of the paddock in Lon Lon Ranch causes a Gold Skulltula to fall from the branches.

evidence.quote:
Roll into the tree southwest of the paddock in Lon Lon Ranch.  The Gold
Skulltula will fall from the branches and land on the ground near you.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch paddock awning
text: Behind the paddock at Lon Lon Ranch, a Gold Skulltula crawls on the steel grating that makes up the back of the awning.

evidence.quote:
Run around to the back of the paddock, to where there is a steel grating which
makes up the back of the awning.  The Gold Skulltula crawls around it here.
You may need to backflip into the token to reach it.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch mill wall
text: A Gold Skulltula is high on the wall to the east of the mill at Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote:
The Gold Skulltula is high on the wall to the east of the mill.  Kill it and
take it's token with the Boomerang.

subject: Kakariko Village entrance tree
text: Rolling into the tree near the entrance to town causes a Gold Skulltula to fall from the branches above.

evidence.quote:
Roll into the tree near the entrance to town.  The Gold Skulltula falls from
the branches above and lands near you.

subject: House of Skulltula window
text: A Gold Skulltula hangs on a window on the backside of the House of Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The Gold Skulltula hangs on a window on the backside of the House of Skulltula.
Run up to it and kill it to get it's token.

subject: Unfinished House brick pile
text: A Gold Skulltula rests on the second level of the pile of bricks in the Unfinished House.

evidence.quote:
The Gold Skulltula rests on the second level of the pile of bricks.  It's
easier if you kill it with the Slingshot instead of trying to climb up and kill
it with the sword.

subject: Kakariko Village tower ladder
text: High on the ladder leading to the top of the tower in the center of town, a Gold Skulltula can be killed with the Slingshot or Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Look high on the ladder leading up to the top of the tower, and you'll see the
Gold Skulltula.  Kill it with the Slingshot or Boomerang before climbing up to
take it.

subject: House near Death Mountain Trail Gate
text: Behind a line of pots on the back of the house closest to Death Mountain Trail Gate lies a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The Gold Skulltula lies on the back of the house closest to Death Mountain
Trail Gate, behind a line of pots.  Smash the pots to get at the Gold
Skulltula, then kill the spider to get it's token.

subject: Impa's House south wall
text: Using the Hookshot to pull onto Impa's House reveals a Gold Skulltula crawling around the south wall near the left corner.

evidence.quote:
Pull yourself on top of Impa's House using the Hookshot.  The Gold Skulltula
crawls around the south wall near the left corner of the house.

subject: Kakariko Graveyard soft earth
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth in the northwest corner of the Graveyard reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Drop a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth in the northwest corner of the
Graveyard.  A Gold Skulltula will appear.  Kill it to get it's token.

subject: Kakariko Graveyard southeast wall
text: Using the Boomerang kills the Gold Skulltula on the southeast wall to the right of Composer Brothers' tombs.

evidence.quote:
Use the Boomerang to kill the Gold Skulltula on the southeast wall.  It's to
the right of Composer Brother's tombs.

subject: Death Mountain Trail right wall alcove
text: Using a bomb on the odd formation on the right wall around the first corner of Death Mountain Trail opens an alcove with a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
There is an odd formation on the wall to the right around the first corner.  Use a bomb to blow
it open.  On the inside is a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it with the Slingshot, then
climb up the inside wall (yes, it's climbable) to get the token.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern entrance soft earth
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth outside Dodongo's Cavern reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Drop a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth outside Dodongo's Cavern.  Kill
the Gold Skulltula and take it's token after it appears.
